description: PowerShell cmdlet to compute cryptographic hashes of files or streams for integrity verification and threat hunting.
prerequisites: Baseline hashes or trusted reference source for comparison

flags.purpose: Compute hash using a specified cryptographic algorithm.
flags.outputs: Hash, Algorithm, and Path of the file.
flags.security_use_case: Verify file integrity against known-good or threat intel hashes.
flags.threat_detected: Trojanized binaries, modified system files, malicious scripts.
flags.risk_if_misused: Weak algorithms like MD5/SHA1 vulnerable to collision attacks.
flags.safe_followup: Validate with digital signature and compare with trusted catalog.

flags.purpose: Hash multiple files for batch integrity verification.
flags.outputs: List of file hashes for comparison and baselining.
flags.security_use_case: Baseline system executables for compromise detection.
flags.threat_detected: Unauthorized executables or modified binaries in system directories.
flags.risk_if_misused: Recursive scans on large paths are time-consuming.

flags.purpose: Hash files with special characters without wildcard interpretation.
flags.outputs: Accurate hash of exact target file.
flags.security_use_case: Verify integrity of frequently targeted files like hosts.
flags.threat_detected: Hosts file tampering for phishing, DNS redirection, or C2.
flags.safe_followup: Inspect file content and restore if altered.

flags.purpose: Hash content from memory stream without relying on file path.
flags.security_use_case: Hash suspicious files before writing to disk or during memory analysis.
flags.risk_if_misused: Improper stream handling may cause resource leaks.
flags.safe_followup: Submit hash to threat intel sources for reputation check.

integrity_workflow: Compare against trusted baseline or vendor catalog

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Creates a baseline of executable hashes for future integrity comparison.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect unauthorized modifications during incident response.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Hunts for suspicious or newly introduced binaries in Program Files.
Verifies integrity of binaries commonly abused for living-off-the-land attacks.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect trojanized command interpreters and script hosts.
